40000537.author: पदार्थः
40000537.content: तत: then, सुरसत्तमै: by best of devatas, नियुक्त: having been employed, नारायण:देव: lord Narayana, जानन्नपि although cognizant of, सुरान् addressing devatas, एवम् in this manner, श्लक्ष्णम् softly, वचनम् words, अब्रवीत् spoke.

40000537.author: Translation
40000537.content: Although Omniscient lord Narayana knew the means to be employed, when he was requested by the best of devatas he spoke to them softly:

40000538.author: पदार्थः
40000538.content: दुरात्मन: of the evil minded, तस्य रावणस्य that Ravana's, वधे in the matter of destruction, उपाय: strategies, क: what?, यम् by which ever strategies, आस्थाय after adopting, ऋषिकण्टकम् thorn by the side of sages(causing sufferings to sages), तम् him, अहम् I, निहन्याम् I shall kill.

40000538.author: Translation
40000538.content: "What strategies should be adopted in the matter of destruction of that evilminded Ravana who is a thorn to the sages?".

40000539.author: पदार्थः
40000539.content: एवम् उक्ता: in this manner addressed, सुरा: the devatas, सर्वे all, अव्ययम् Imperishable, विष्णुम् Vishnu, प्रत्यूचु: replied back, मानुषीम् relaing to human being, तनुम् body, आस्थाय assuming, संयुगे in the battle, रावणम् जहि kill Ravana.

40000539.author: Translation
40000539.content: When the devatas were thus addressed by the imperishable Visnu, they replied him saying, "You may assume the form of a human being and slay Ravana in the battle".

40000540.author: पदार्थः
40000540.content: अरिन्दम ODestroyer of foes, स: Ravana, दीर्घकालम् for long time, तीव्रम् severe, तप: penance, तेपे performed, येन by which, लोककृत् creator of the world, लोकपूर्वज: born prior to the creation of the worlds, ब्रह्मा Brahma, तुष्ट:अभवत् was very pleased.

40000540.author: Translation
40000540.content: "O destroyer of foes Lord Brahma was very pleased with Ravana's intense penance over a long time৷৷

40000541.author: पदार्थः
40000541.content: सन्तुष्ट: very pleased, प्रभु: all powerful Brahma, तस्मै राक्षसाय for that rakshasa, मानुषात् अन्यत्र except from men, नानाविधेभ्य: from several others, भूतेभ्य: from living beings, भयम्  fear, न none, वरम् boon, प्रददौ granted, पुरा earlier, वरदाने at the time of granting boon, तेन by him, मानवा: men, अवज्ञाता: were disregarded.

40000541.author: Translation
40000541.content: Pleased, with the rakshasa Brahma granted a boon to the effect that except from men, there was, for him, no fear of death from any other living beings. Ravana ignored men while seeking the boon.

40000542.author: पदार्थः
40000542.content: एवम् in this manner, तस्मात् पितामहात् from that Brahma, वरम् boon, प्राप्य having obtained,  स: Ravana, दर्पित: became arrogant, त्रीन् three, लोकान् worlds, उत्सादयति destroyed,  स्त्रिय: women, अपकर्षति च carries away by violence, तस्मात् for that reason, परन्तप O Destroyer of foes, तस्य वध: killing him, मानुषेभ्य: from(by) men, दृष्ट: has been seen.

40000542.author: Translation
40000542.content: Having obtained the boon from Brahma, Ravana, greed and arrogant went on bringing  destruction to the three worlds. He carried away women by violence. O destroyer of foes his death is possible by men only."

40000543.author: पदार्थः
40000543.content: एवम् in this manner, तस्मात् पितामहात् from that Brahma, वरम् boon, प्राप्य having obtained,  स: Ravana, दर्पित: became arrogant, त्रीन् three, लोकान् worlds, उत्सादयति destroyed,  स्त्रिय: women, अपकर्षति च carries away by violence, तस्मात् for that reason, परन्तप O Destroyer of foes, तस्य वध: killing him, मानुषेभ्य: from(by) men, दृष्ट: has been seen.

40000543.author: Translation
40000543.content: Having obtained the boon from Brahma, Ravana, greed and arrogant went on bringing  destruction to the three worlds. He carried away women by violence. O destroyer of foes his death is possible by men only."

40000544.author: पदार्थः
40000544.content: इति in this manner, सुराणाम् devatas, एतत् वचनम् these words, श्रुत्वा having heard, आत्मवान् intellectual, विष्णु: Visnu, तदा then, दशरथं नृपम्  king Dasaratha, पितरम् as father, रोचयामास liked (chosen).

40000544.author: Translation
40000544.content: Having heard the words of devatas, selfpossessed Visnu chose king Dasaratha as his father.

40000545.author: पदार्थः
40000545.content: तस्मिन् काले at that time, महाद्युति: effulgent, अरिसूदन: destroyer of enemies, स:नृपति: that king, अपुत्र: without sons, पुत्रेप्सु: wishing to beget sons, पुत्रियाम् इष्टिम् a sacrifice to obtain sons, अयजत् performed.

40000545.author: Translation
40000545.content: At that time, the brilliant king (Dasaratha), destroyer of enemies, who had no sons was performing a sacrifice for sons.

40000546.author: पदार्थः
40000546.content: स: विष्णु: Vishnu, निश्चयं कृत्वा having decided, पितामहम् Grandsire, Brahma, आमन्त्र्य bidding farewell, देवै: by devatas, महर्षिभि: by maharshis, पूज्यमान: worshipped by, अन्तर्धानं गत: disappeared.

40000546.author: Translation
40000546.content: After Visnu had decided (to incarnate) and he was worshipped by devatas and maharshis he disappeared bidding farewell to Brahma.

40000547.author: पदार्थः
40000547.content: तत: then, यजमानस्य  while Dasaratha was performing the sacrifice, पावकात् from the sacrificial fire, अतुलप्रभम् of unmatched splendour, महावीर्यम् of great prowess, महाबलम् great strength, कृष्णं रक्ताम्बरधरम् clad in black and crimpson garment, रक्तास्यम् redfaced, दुन्दुभिस्वनम् having a voice similar to the sounds of drum, स्निग्धहर्यक्षतनुजश्मश्रुप्रवरमूर्धजम्  with whiskers of soft and shining  tawny hair resembling mane of lion and excellent hair, शुभलक्षणसम्पन्नम् endowed with auspicious signs, दिव्याभरणभूषितम् adorned with splendid divine ornaments, शैलश्रुङ्गसमुत्सेथम् resembling the height of a peak of a mountain, दृप्तशार्दूलविक्रमम् having the strides of an arrogant tiger, दिवाकरसमाकारम्  similar to the Sun in radiance, दीप्तानलशिखोपमम् looking like the crest of blazing fire, महत् great, भूतम् being, तप्तजाम्बूनदमयीम् made of gold purified in fire, राजतान्तपरिच्छदाम् made of silver, दिव्यपायससम्पूर्णाम् filled with divine (excellent) Payasam(a preparation of rice in milk and sugar), मायामयीमिव as if made out of illusion, विपुलाम् large, पात्रीम् vessel, प्रियां पत्नीमिव like a beloved wife, स्वयम् on his own, दोर्भ्याम् with both the hands, प्रगृह्य holding, प्रादुर्भूतम् emerged.

40000547.author: Translation
40000547.content: During the sacrifice, there emerged from the sacrificial fire a mighty being with unmatched splendour, his prowess and strength. He wore a black and crimson garment. He had a red face. His voice was similar to the sounds of a drum. He had whiskers of soft and shining tawny hair resembling the mane of a lion He had fine hair on his head. He was endowed with auspicious signs and adorned with splendid divine ornaments. His height resembled a mountain peak. He walked with the strides of a ferocious tiger. Similar to the Sun in radiance, he looked like the crest of a blazing fire. This divine being held like his beloved wife both hands, a large vessel made of gold purified, in fire, covered with a silver lid and filled with payasam (a preparation of rice in milk and sugar). It looked as though it was created  by magic.

40000548.author: पदार्थः
40000548.content: तत: then, यजमानस्य  while Dasaratha was performing the sacrifice, पावकात् from the sacrificial fire, अतुलप्रभम् of unmatched splendour, महावीर्यम् of great prowess, महाबलम् great strength, कृष्णं रक्ताम्बरधरम् clad in black and crimpson garment, रक्तास्यम् redfaced, दुन्दुभिस्वनम् having a voice similar to the sounds of drum, स्निग्धहर्यक्षतनुजश्मश्रुप्रवरमूर्धजम्  with whiskers of soft and shining  tawny hair resembling mane of lion and excellent hair, शुभलक्षणसम्पन्नम् endowed with auspicious signs, दिव्याभरणभूषितम् adorned with splendid divine ornaments, शैलश्रुङ्गसमुत्सेथम् resembling the height of a peak of a mountain, दृप्तशार्दूलविक्रमम् having the strides of an arrogant tiger, दिवाकरसमाकारम्  similar to the Sun in radiance, दीप्तानलशिखोपमम् looking like the crest of blazing fire, महत् great, भूतम् being, तप्तजाम्बूनदमयीम् made of gold purified in fire, राजतान्तपरिच्छदाम् made of silver, दिव्यपायससम्पूर्णाम् filled with divine (excellent) Payasam(a preparation of rice in milk and sugar), मायामयीमिव as if made out of illusion, विपुलाम् large, पात्रीम् vessel, प्रियां पत्नीमिव like a beloved wife, स्वयम् on his own, दोर्भ्याम् with both the hands, प्रगृह्य holding, प्रादुर्भूतम् emerged.

40000552.author: पदार्थः
40000552.content: दशरथं नृपम् king Dasaratha, समवेक्ष्य seeing him, इदम् वाक्यम् these words, अब्रवीत् had spoken, नृप Oking, इह अभ्यागतम् have come here, प्राजापत्यम् from Prajapati (Brahma), नरम् person, विद्धि you know.

40000552.author: Translation
40000552.content: Having seen king Dasaratha, he said, "O King you know I have been sent by Prjapati (Brahma), and I am here".

40000553.author: पदार्थः
40000553.content: तत:परम् thereafter, तदा then, राजा king, कृताञ्जलि: with folded palms, प्रत्युवाच replied, भगवन् O Revered lord, ते स्वागतम् अस्तु welcome to you, अहम् I, ते to you, किम् what, करवाणि can do.

40000553.author: Translation
40000553.content: With folded palms the king replied, "O revered lord. Welcome to you. What can I do for you?".

40000554.author: पदार्थः
40000554.content: अथो thereafter, प्राजापत्य: the being sent by Prajapati, नर: that person, पुन: again, इदं वाक्यम् these words, अब्रवीत् spoke, राजन् O king, देवान्  devatas, अर्चयता while  worshipping, त्वया by you, अद्य today, इदं this, प्राप्तम् obtained.

40000554.author: Translation
40000554.content: Thereafter the one who came from Prajapati answered, "O King you have obtained this payasam today in return for the worship offered to the devatas".

40000555.author: पदार्थः
40000555.content: नृपशार्दूल O Best among kings, देवनिर्मितम् prepared by gods, प्रजाकरम् conferring progeny, धन्यम् bestowing affluence, आरोग्यवर्धनम् helps in improving health, इदम् पायसम् this Payasam, त्वम् you, गृहाण receive.

40000555.author: Translation
40000555.content: "O Lion among kings, receive this payasam prepared by gods, conferring progeny, bestowing affluence and improving health.

40000556.author: पदार्थः
40000556.content: नृप O King, अश्नीत इति "consume it", अनुरूपाणाम् worthy, भार्याणाम् consorts, प्रयच्छ वै give it to them, यदर्थम् for whose sake, यजसे  you are performing  this sacrifice, पुत्रान् such sons, तासु inthem, त्वम् you, प्राप्स्यसे will obtain.

40000556.author: Translation
40000556.content: O King you are performing this sacrifice for the sake of sons. Give this to your  worthy consorts to consume it. They will bear you sons".

40000557.author: पदार्थः
40000557.content: नृपति: king, तथेति so be it, तां देवान्नसम्पूर्णाम् all that food prepared by deities, देवदत्ताम् bestowed by devatas, हिरण्मयीम् golden, पात्रीम् vessel, शिरसा by lowering his head respectfully, प्रतिगृह्य having received, प्रीत: pleased.

40000557.author: Translation
40000557.content: Dasaratha was pleased to receive respectfully the golden vessel filled with the payasam  prepared and bestowed by devatas.

40000558.author: पदार्थः
40000558.content: परमया by utmost, मुदा युक्त: endowed with joy, अद्भुतम् wonderful, प्रियदर्शनम् having pleasant countenance, तत् भूतम् that being, अभिवाद्य having saluated, प्रदक्षिणम् चकार  circumambulated.

40000558.author: Translation
40000558.content: Overwhelmed with great joy, he, walked around that wonderful being of pleasant  countenance again and again and saluated him respectfully.

40000559.author: पदार्थः
40000559.content: तत: afterthat, दशरथ: Dasaratha, देवनिर्मितम् prepared by devatas, पायसम् Payasam, प्राप्य having obtained, वित्तम् wealth, प्राप्य having got, अधन:इव like a person having no wealth, परमप्रीत:बभूव was highly pleased.

40000559.author: Translation
40000559.content: Dasaratha who received the payasam prepared by devatas was highly pleased like a poor man who received wealth.

40000560.author: पदार्थः
40000560.content: तत: then, अद्भुतप्रख्यम् having a wonderful form, परमभास्वरम् highly effulgent, तद्भूतम् that being, तत्कर्म that task, संवर्तयित्वा having performed, तत्रैव from there, अन्तरधीयत disappeared.

40000560.author: Translation
40000560.content: Then that effulgent figure of wonderful form having given the bowl of payasam vanished from there.

40000561.author: पदार्थः
40000561.content: हर्षरश्मिभि: with rays of happiness, उद्द्योतम् got brightened, तस्य his, अन्त:पुरम् inner apartment, अभिरामस्य delightful, शारदस्य autumnal, चन्द्रस्य moon's, अंशुभि: beams, नभ:इव like sky, आबभौ shone.

40000561.author: Translation
40000561.content: The inner apartment, brightened with rays of happiness, shone like the autumnal sky in the glow of the moon.

40000562.author: पदार्थः
40000562.content: स: he, अन्त:पुरम् inner apartment, प्रविश्यैव after entering, कौसल्याम् addressing queen Kausalya, इदम् these words, अब्रवीत् spoke, आत्मन: for you, पुत्रीयम् bestowing sons, इदम् this, पायसम् Payasam, प्रतिगृह्णीष्व receive it.

40000562.author: Translation
40000562.content: He entered the inner apartment and addressing queen Kausalya said, "Receive this payasam which has the power to give you sons".

40000563.author: पदार्थः
40000563.content: तदा then, नरपति: king Dasaratha, कौसल्यायै for Kausalya, पायसार्धम् half of Payasa, ददौ gave, नराधिप: king, अर्धात् from the half portion, अर्धम् half of it, सुमित्रायै अपि for Sumitra also, ददौ gave, अवशिष्टार्धम् the remaining half, पुत्रार्थकारणात् for the sake of son, कैकेय्यै for Kaikeyi, ददौ gave, महीपति: king, अनुचिन्त्य having thought over, पायसस्य Payasam, अमृतोपमम् resembling ambrosia, अवसिष्टार्धम् the remaining half, पुनरेव again, सुमित्रायै for Sumitra, प्रददौ gave, एवम् in this manner, राजा king, तासां भार्याणाम् for his wives, पृथक् separately, पायसम् Payasam, ददौ gave.

40000563.author: Translation
40000563.content: Then Dasaratha gave half the portion of payasam to Kausalya, half of the remaining half to Sumitra, half of the remaining portion (oneeighth of original) to Kaikeyi for the sake of a son. On further thinking, he gave the remaining oneeighth portion to Sumitra. In this manner the king divided and distributed the payasam among his wives separately.

40000564.author: पदार्थः
40000564.content: तदा then, नरपति: king Dasaratha, कौसल्यायै for Kausalya, पायसार्धम् half of Payasa, ददौ gave, नराधिप: king, अर्धात् from the half portion, अर्धम् half of it, सुमित्रायै अपि for Sumitra also, ददौ gave, अवशिष्टार्धम् the remaining half, पुत्रार्थकारणात् for the sake of son, कैकेय्यै for Kaikeyi, ददौ gave, महीपति: king, अनुचिन्त्य having thought over, पायसस्य Payasam, अमृतोपमम् resembling ambrosia, अवसिष्टार्धम् the remaining half, पुनरेव again, सुमित्रायै for Sumitra, प्रददौ gave, एवम् in this manner, राजा king, तासां भार्याणाम् for his wives, पृथक् separately, पायसम् Payasam, ददौ gave.

40000564.author: Translation
40000564.content: Then Dasaratha gave half the portion of payasam to Kausalya, half of the remaining half to Sumitra, half of the remaining portion (oneeighth of original) to Kaikeyi for the sake of a son. On further thinking, he gave the remaining oneeighth portion to Sumitra. In this manner the king divided and distributed the payasam among his wives separately.

40000565.author: पदार्थः
40000565.content: तदा then, नरपति: king Dasaratha, कौसल्यायै for Kausalya, पायसार्धम् half of Payasa, ददौ gave, नराधिप: king, अर्धात् from the half portion, अर्धम् half of it, सुमित्रायै अपि for Sumitra also, ददौ gave, अवशिष्टार्धम् the remaining half, पुत्रार्थकारणात् for the sake of son, कैकेय्यै for Kaikeyi, ददौ gave, महीपति: king, अनुचिन्त्य having thought over, पायसस्य Payasam, अमृतोपमम् resembling ambrosia, अवसिष्टार्धम् the remaining half, पुनरेव again, सुमित्रायै for Sumitra, प्रददौ gave, एवम् in this manner, राजा king, तासां भार्याणाम् for his wives, पृथक् separately, पायसम् Payasam, ददौ gave.

40000565.author: Translation
40000565.content: Then Dasaratha gave half the portion of payasam to Kausalya, half of the remaining half to Sumitra, half of the remaining portion (oneeighth of original) to Kaikeyi for the sake of a son. On further thinking, he gave the remaining oneeighth portion to Sumitra. In this manner the king divided and distributed the payasam among his wives separately.

40000566.author: पदार्थः
40000566.content: नरेन्द्रस्य king's, उत्तमा: excellent, ता:स्त्रिय: those women, सर्वा: all, एतत् this, पायसम् Payasam, प्राप्य having received, प्रहर्षोदितचेतस: minds filled with delight, सम्मानम्  honour  मेनिरे considered.

40000566.author: Translation
40000566.content: The virtuous wives of the king were exceedingly delighted and felt honoured after receiving the payasam .

40000567.author: पदार्थः
40000567.content: ततः then, महीपते: king's, ता:उत्तमास्त्रिय: excellent consorts, तत् उत्तमपायसम् that choicest Payasam, पृथक् separately, प्राश्य having consumed, हुताशनादित्यसमानतेजस: resembling glowing fire and Sun in lustre, अचिरेण after short gap of time, तदा then, गर्भान् प्रतिपेदिरे became pregnant.

40000567.author: Translation
40000567.content: Then the excellent consorts of the king who glowed like fire and the Sun, having consumed the choicest payasam, became pregnant in a short time.

40000568.author: पदार्थः
40000568.content: तत: then, राजा king, प्ररूढगर्भा: pregnant women, ता: स्त्रिय: those wives, प्रसमीक्ष्य having seen, प्रतिलब्धमानस: having regained composure of mind, त्रिदिवे in the heavens, सुरेन्द्रसिद्धर्षिगणाभिपूजित: worshipped by Indra, hosts of siddhas and rishis, यथा हरि: like Visnu, हृष्ट:बभूव became delighted.

40000568.author: Translation
40000568.content: The king now regained his composure of mind on seeing his pregnant wives. He looked delighted like Visnu worshipped by Indra, and hosts of siddhas and rishis. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये बालकाण्डे षोडशस्सर्ग:।। Thus ends the sixteenth sarga of Balakanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
